title: Claude Code + Remotion: 20 Failed Videos Became 3 Skills You Can Install
description:
Build a video pipeline with Claude Code and Remotion, and turn each failure into a skill you can share. Install the three skills from this video:

/plugin marketplace add DustinDoan315/video-pipeline-skills
/plugin install video-pipeline@dustin-builds

Skills repo: https://github.com/DustinDoan315/video-pipeline-skills
Remotion: https://www.remotion.dev

#ClaudeCode #Remotion
